units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|name|224|0
units.english: Transport Successor stargazers
units.italian: Trasporta gli osservatori di stelle Successori

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|description|225|0
units.english: Transport a pair of Successor stargazers to <planet stopovers> and return them home to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Trasporta due osservatori di stelle Successori fino a <planet stopovers> e riportali a casa, su <destination>, entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|While in the spaceport on <origin>, you notice a pair of tired-looking Successors lugging around a cart of a curious folded material, taking turns dragging their apparently heavy luggage over the floor. Both perk up substantially when they see you and your ship, however, and pull their equipment towards you with renewed vigor, finally getting close enough to speak.|240|0
units.english: While in the spaceport on <origin>, you notice a pair of tired-looking Successors lugging around a cart of a curious folded material, taking turns dragging their apparently heavy luggage over the floor. Both perk up substantially when they see you and your ship, however, and pull their equipment towards you with renewed vigor, finally getting close enough to speak.
units.italian: Mentre sei nello spazioporto di <origin>, noti due Successori dall'aria stanca che trascinano un carretto con un curioso materiale piegato, alternandosi nel tirare sul pavimento il loro bagaglio evidentemente pesante. Entrambi si rianimano parecchio quando vedono te e la tua nave, però, e tirano l'attrezzatura verso di te con rinnovato vigore, riuscendo infine ad avvicinarsi abbastanza da parlare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	The larger of the two begins, "Oh! Thour't that recent alien, no? 'Tis a gorgeous ship thou commands-"|241|0
units.english: The larger of the two begins, "Oh! Thour't that recent alien, no? 'Tis a gorgeous ship thou commands-"
units.italian: Il più grande dei due comincia: "Oh! Sei quell'alieno recente, no? È una nave bellissima quella che comandi..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"What we meant to say is-"|242|0
units.english: "What we meant to say is-"
units.italian: "Quello che volevamo dire è..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Sorry, 'tis just that-" |243|0
units.english: "Sorry, 'tis just that-"
units.italian: "Scusa, è solo che..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Do you take passenger missions?"|244|0
units.english: "Do you take passenger missions?"
units.italian: "Accetti missioni passeggeri?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"I do."|246|0
units.english: "I do."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"It depends for what purpose."|248|0
units.english: "It depends for what purpose."
units.italian: "Dipende dallo scopo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	One of the Successors looks what you might call embarrassed, flushing a dull green. The other replies.|249|0
units.english: One of the Successors looks what you might call embarrassed, flushing a dull green. The other replies.
units.italian: Uno dei Successori assume quella che potresti definire un'aria imbarazzata, arrossendo di un verde spento. L'altro risponde.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Stargazing. There is a world at the edge of the galaxy, the farthest edge; it has the most beautiful view-"|250|0
units.english: "Stargazing. There is a world at the edge of the galaxy, the farthest edge; it has the most beautiful view-"
units.italian: "Osservazione delle stelle. C'è un mondo al bordo della galassia, il bordo più lontano; ha la vista più bella..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"We've brought our own equipment."|251|0
units.english: "We've brought our own equipment."
units.italian: "Abbiamo portato la nostra attrezzatura."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"The sky there's divided into star-studded night and utter void. Could thou take us there?"|252|0
units.english: "The sky there's divided into star-studded night and utter void. Could thou take us there?"
units.italian: "Il cielo, lì, è diviso fra notte stellata e vuoto assoluto. Potresti portarci?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"And back, of course. And our cargo," the other one says, gesturing towards the cart of folded fabric.|253|0
units.english: "And back, of course. And our cargo," the other one says, gesturing towards the cart of folded fabric.
units.italian: "E riportarci indietro, naturalmente. E il nostro carico," dice l'altro, indicando il carretto di tessuto piegato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"And back. And our cargo. We can give thee modest pay."|254|0
units.english: "And back. And our cargo. We can give thee modest pay."
units.italian: "E ritorno. E il nostro carico. Possiamo darti un compenso modesto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Sure, I can take you."|256|0
units.english: "Sure, I can take you."
units.italian: "Certo, posso portarvi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"You'll have to find a different pilot."|258|0
units.english: "You'll have to find a different pilot."
units.italian: "Dovrete trovare un altro pilota."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh! 'Tis perfect! We were looking for a private transport. We're stargazers-"|261|0
units.english: "Oh! 'Tis perfect! We were looking for a private transport. We're stargazers-"
units.italian: "Oh! È perfetto! Cercavamo un trasporto privato. Siamo osservatori di stelle..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"There's a planet at the edge of the galaxy with the perfect view-"|262|0
units.english: "There's a planet at the edge of the galaxy with the perfect view-"
units.italian: "C'è un pianeta al bordo della galassia con la vista perfetta..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"The sky there's divided into star-studded night and utter void. Could thou take us there?"|263|0
units.english: "The sky there's divided into star-studded night and utter void. Could thou take us there?"
units.italian: "Il cielo, lì, è diviso fra notte stellata e vuoto assoluto. Potresti portarci?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"And back, of course. And our cargo too," the other one says, gesturing towards the cart of folded fabric.|264|0
units.english: "And back, of course. And our cargo too," the other one says, gesturing towards the cart of folded fabric.
units.italian: "E riportarci indietro, naturalmente. E anche il nostro carico," dice l'altro, indicando il carretto di tessuto piegato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"And back. And our cargo. We can give thee modest pay."|265|0
units.english: "And back. And our cargo. We can give thee modest pay."
units.italian: "E ritorno. E il nostro carico. Possiamo darti un compenso modesto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Sure, I can take you."|267|0
units.english: "Sure, I can take you."
units.italian: "Certo, posso portarvi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"I'm sorry, but you'll have to find a different pilot."|269|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but you'll have to find a different pilot."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma dovrete trovare un altro pilota."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	The two seem thrilled, the larger one turning a dull pink. "Oh! Thour't truly honorable, noble alien. I am Nnesa."|272|0
units.english: The two seem thrilled, the larger one turning a dull pink. "Oh! Thour't truly honorable, noble alien. I am Nnesa."
units.italian: I due sembrano rapiti, e il più grande diventa di un rosa spento. "Oh! Sei davvero onorevole, nobile alieno. Io sono Nnesa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Jaasora. Thank you, Captain. Most pilots here've no appetite to travel to the uninhabited systems."|273|0
units.english: "Jaasora. Thank you, Captain. Most pilots here've no appetite to travel to the uninhabited systems."
units.italian: "Jaasora. Grazie, capitano. Quasi nessun pilota qui ha voglia di andare nei sistemi disabitati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Yes, you must tell us about all the places you've been-"|274|0
units.english: "Yes, you must tell us about all the places you've been-"
units.italian: "Sì, devi raccontarci di tutti i posti in cui sei stato..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"How about we get you onboard first."|276|0
units.english: "How about we get you onboard first."
units.italian: "Prima facciamo salire voi a bordo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	Nnesa flashes with embarrassment once again, but Jaasora offers a supportive arm, wrapping it around their body. The two enlist your help in loading their cart of equipment, which is much heavier than it looks, but together the three of you eventually manage to maneuver their luggage into the <ship>'s cargo bay and are ready for departure.|277|0
units.english: Nnesa flashes with embarrassment once again, but Jaasora offers a supportive arm, wrapping it around their body. The two enlist your help in loading their cart of equipment, which is much heavier than it looks, but together the three of you eventually manage to maneuver their luggage into the <ship>'s cargo bay and are ready for departure.
units.italian: Nnesa va in confusione ancora una volta, ma Jaasora offre un braccio di sostegno, avvolgendolo intorno al suo corpo. I due ti chiedono aiuto per caricare il loro carretto di attrezzatura, che è molto più pesante di quanto sembri, ma insieme riuscite infine a sistemare il loro bagaglio nella stiva della <ship> e a essere pronti a partire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|Nnesa and Jaasora have been simply enthralled on the journey here; the inseparable pair has spent seemingly every waking moment peering out the <ship>'s windows to watch the stars stream past. Upon arrival in the Maspa-Mavra system, however, their excitement dwindled to what you would call a subdued awe at the sight of the entire galaxy splayed out in the sky.|281|0
units.english: Nnesa and Jaasora have been simply enthralled on the journey here; the inseparable pair has spent seemingly every waking moment peering out the <ship>'s windows to watch the stars stream past. Upon arrival in the Maspa-Mavra system, however, their excitement dwindled to what you would call a subdued awe at the sight of the entire galaxy splayed out in the sky.
units.italian: Nnesa e Jaasora sono stati semplicemente rapiti durante il viaggio; la coppia inseparabile ha passato, a quanto pare, ogni momento di veglia a guardare fuori dai finestrini della <ship> le stelle che scorrevano. All'arrivo nel sistema Maspa-Mavra, però, il loro entusiasmo si è ridotto a quella che potresti chiamare una soggezione sommessa davanti all'intera galassia spiegata nel cielo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	Khosa-Kella-Oa itself is cold, dark and rocky: for all purposes functionally identical to any of the other innumerable uninhabited airless worlds in the galaxy. Your passengers seem pleased with it, though; Nnesa remarks that the local star "is so dim that there's hardly any glare!" and Jaasora energetically agrees. They activate their cart of folded equipment within the <ship>'s cargo bay, which slowly inflates and unfolds into something halfway between a tent and a repulsor lift. It skids over the floor like melting ice, gently bumping the inside walls a couple times before Jaasora manages to quiet its movement.|282|0
units.english: Khosa-Kella-Oa itself is cold, dark and rocky: for all purposes functionally identical to any of the other innumerable uninhabited airless worlds in the galaxy. Your passengers seem pleased with it, though; Nnesa remarks that the local star "is so dim that there's hardly any glare!" and Jaasora energetically agrees. They activate their cart of folded equipment within the <ship>'s cargo bay, which slowly inflates and unfolds into something halfway between a tent and a repulsor lift. It skids over the floor like melting ice, gently bumping the inside walls a couple times before Jaasora manages to quiet its movement.
units.italian: Khosa-Kella-Oa in sé è freddo, scuro e roccioso: a tutti gli effetti identico a qualunque altro degli innumerevoli mondi disabitati e senz'aria della galassia. I tuoi passeggeri sembrano comunque soddisfatti; Nnesa fa notare che la stella locale "è così fioca che non c'è quasi alcun bagliore!" e Jaasora concorda con energia. Attivano il carretto di attrezzatura piegata nella stiva della <ship>, che lentamente si gonfia e si dispiega in qualcosa a metà fra una tenda e un sollevatore a repulsione. Scivola sul pavimento come ghiaccio che si scioglie, sbattendo piano contro le pareti interne un paio di volte prima che Jaasora riesca a fermarne il movimento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Our thanks again, captain, for transporting us," says Jaasora as they load a bundle of telescopes inside.|283|0
units.english: "Our thanks again, captain, for transporting us," says Jaasora as they load a bundle of telescopes inside.
units.italian: "Grazie ancora, capitano, per averci trasportato," dice Jaasora mentre carica un fascio di telescopi all'interno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh! The planet's perfect; no air to muddy the view nor other ships to cloud the skies-"|284|0
units.english: "Oh! The planet's perfect; no air to muddy the view nor other ships to cloud the skies-"
units.italian: "Oh! Il pianeta è perfetto; nessun'aria a intorbidire la vista e nessun'altra nave a offuscare i cieli..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"We should be back in a couple hours. Please wait for us."|285|0
units.english: "We should be back in a couple hours. Please wait for us."
units.italian: "Dovremmo essere di ritorno fra un paio d'ore. Ti prego di aspettarci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	The pair depart in their gliding tent, which manifests several transparent spots on its surface as it exits and as a bevy of telescopes are prodded around inside.|286|0
units.english: The pair depart in their gliding tent, which manifests several transparent spots on its surface as it exits and as a bevy of telescopes are prodded around inside.
units.italian: La coppia parte nella loro tenda planante, che mentre esce mostra diverse macchie trasparenti sulla superficie, con una serie di telescopi che vengono spostati all'interno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	(Wait.)|288|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	Nnesa and Jaasora return after a couple of hours as promised, their strange tent gliding back into the <ship>'s cargo bay as smoothly as it exited. The pair unload several notebooks of photos and drawings and chatter excitedly about the various constellations and stellar phenomena that they observed. Nnesa is particularly excited, hurriedly extracting from the interleaved mess of papers a surprisingly accurate and well-constructed star map, which they press up in your face with pride. You cannot help but notice that several of the drawings in the stack are of Jaasora rather than of any stellar phenomena.|289|0
units.english: Nnesa and Jaasora return after a couple of hours as promised, their strange tent gliding back into the <ship>'s cargo bay as smoothly as it exited. The pair unload several notebooks of photos and drawings and chatter excitedly about the various constellations and stellar phenomena that they observed. Nnesa is particularly excited, hurriedly extracting from the interleaved mess of papers a surprisingly accurate and well-constructed star map, which they press up in your face with pride. You cannot help but notice that several of the drawings in the stack are of Jaasora rather than of any stellar phenomena.
units.italian: Nnesa e Jaasora tornano dopo un paio d'ore come promesso, con la loro strana tenda che rientra nella stiva della <ship> con la stessa scorrevolezza con cui era uscita. La coppia scarica diversi quaderni di foto e disegni e chiacchiera con eccitazione delle varie costellazioni e dei fenomeni stellari che hanno osservato. Nnesa è particolarmente su di giri e, tirando fuori in fretta dal disordine di fogli una mappa stellare sorprendentemente accurata e ben costruita, te la sventola in faccia con orgoglio. Non puoi fare a meno di notare che diversi disegni nella pila ritraggono Jaasora invece di qualche fenomeno stellare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"From where on the map dost thou hail, captain?" Nnesa roughly gestures to an area of their map that you recognize as human space.|290|0
units.english: "From where on the map dost thou hail, captain?" Nnesa roughly gestures to an area of their map that you recognize as human space.
units.italian: "Da quale punto della mappa vieni, capitano?" Nnesa indica con un gesto approssimativo una zona della loro mappa che riconosci come spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	(Indicate <home system>.)|292|0
units.english: (Indicate <home system>.)
units.italian: (Indica <home system>.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	(Indicate Sol.)|296|0
units.english: (Indicate Sol.)
units.italian: (Indica Sol.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	(Indicate <home system>.)|300|0
units.english: (Indicate <home system>.)
units.italian: (Indica <home system>.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	(Gesture broadly to the expanse of space depicted on the map.)|304|0
units.english: (Gesture broadly to the expanse of space depicted on the map.)
units.italian: (Indica con un gesto ampio la distesa di spazio raffigurata sulla mappa.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh!" says Nnesa, "Thou art a scion of the constellations, first and foremost to the stars? 'Tis fair. Thou hast a galaxy to wander, a nearly endless sky. The things that there must be to see-"|305|0
units.english: "Oh!" says Nnesa, "Thou art a scion of the constellations, first and foremost to the stars? 'Tis fair. Thou hast a galaxy to wander, a nearly endless sky. The things that there must be to see-"
units.italian: "Oh!" dice Nnesa, "sei un erede delle costellazioni, prima di tutto alle stelle? È giusto. Hai una galassia da vagare, un cielo quasi senza fine. Le cose che ci devono essere da vedere..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh!" says Nnesa, "I am not sure I know the name for that one, captain. What dost thou call thy home?"|308|0
units.english: "Oh!" says Nnesa, "I am not sure I know the name for that one, captain. What dost thou call thy home?"
units.italian: "Oh!" dice Nnesa, "non sono sicuro di conoscere il nome di quella, capitano. Come chiami la tua casa?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"<home system>," you reply.|309|0
units.english: "<home system>," you reply.
units.italian: "<home system>," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh!" says Nnesa, "Sol." They quietly sound their way through the word a couple times, trying to get it right. "Our name for it is Saaqa-Viirja. 'Twas one of the northernmost extents of our Predecessors' voyages. Ah. But thou know'st this already, for sure."|312|0
units.english: "Oh!" says Nnesa, "Sol." They quietly sound their way through the word a couple times, trying to get it right. "Our name for it is Saaqa-Viirja. 'Twas one of the northernmost extents of our Predecessors' voyages. Ah. But thou know'st this already, for sure."
units.italian: "Oh!" dice Nnesa, "Sol." Si fanno silenziosamente strada nella parola un paio di volte, cercando di pronunciarla bene. "Il nostro nome per questo è Saaqa-Viirja. Era uno dei limiti più a nord dei viaggi dei nostri Predecessori. Ah. Ma tu questo lo sai già, di sicuro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|label|314|0
units.english: fah soom
units.italian: fah soom

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"Oh!" says Nnesa. "That far to the north? Thy kind must have spread far for thee to have such a place as thy home. What dost thou call it?"|315|0
units.english: "Oh!" says Nnesa. "That far to the north? Thy kind must have spread far for thee to have such a place as thy home. What dost thou call it?"
units.italian: "Oh!" dice Nnesa. "Così lontano a nord? La tua specie deve essersi diffusa molto perché tu abbia un posto del genere come casa. Come lo chiami?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	"<home system>," you reply.|316|0
units.english: "<home system>," you reply.
units.italian: "<home system>," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|label|317|0
units.english: novel name
units.italian: novel name

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	Nnesa asks you to repeat the word a second time, slowly working their way through your pronunciation and transcribing a short sequence of flowing letters on their map. "'Tis a pleasant name," they say.|318|0
units.english: Nnesa asks you to repeat the word a second time, slowly working their way through your pronunciation and transcribing a short sequence of flowing letters on their map. "'Tis a pleasant name," they say.
units.italian: Nnesa ti chiede di ripetere la parola una seconda volta, seguendo lentamente la tua pronuncia e trascrivendo sul loro una breve sequenza di lettere fluenti. "È un nome piacevole," dicono.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|	The two of you are interrupted by Jaasora, who needs Nnesa's help to pack the now-deflating tent back in its cart, and once that is done they indicate that they are ready to return home.|320|0
units.english: The two of you are interrupted by Jaasora, who needs Nnesa's help to pack the now-deflating tent back in its cart, and once that is done they indicate that they are ready to return home.
units.italian: Venite interrotti da Jaasora, che ha bisogno dell'aiuto di Nnesa per richiudere nella cesta la tenda ora sgonfia, e quando hanno finito ti fanno capire che sono pronti a tornare a casa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Stargazing 1|Nnesa and Jaasora have continued to marvel at the stars on the way back home, in addition to spending a substantial amount of time poring over their mutual collection of photos, drawings, and maps from Maspa-Mavra. "Our deepest thanks, captain," Jaasora says to you once you have landed in the spaceport as Nnesa wrestles with the tent and cart. "'Twas a true and joyful voyage." Nnesa calls them over; the tent clearly requires at least two to handle. Jaasora presents you with your payment of <payment> and goes to help, and the two of them maneuver their equipment out of your cargo bay before shouting a hasty but good-humored farewell.|325|0
units.english: Nnesa and Jaasora have continued to marvel at the stars on the way back home, in addition to spending a substantial amount of time poring over their mutual collection of photos, drawings, and maps from Maspa-Mavra. "Our deepest thanks, captain," Jaasora says to you once you have landed in the spaceport as Nnesa wrestles with the tent and cart. "'Twas a true and joyful voyage." Nnesa calls them over; the tent clearly requires at least two to handle. Jaasora presents you with your payment of <payment> and goes to help, and the two of them maneuver their equipment out of your cargo bay before shouting a hasty but good-humored farewell.
units.italian: Nnesa e Jaasora continuano a meravigliarsi delle stelle sulla via del ritorno, oltre a passare molto tempo chini sulla loro collezione comune di foto, disegni e mappe di Maspa-Mavra. "La nostra più profonda gratitudine, capitano," ti dice Jaasora una volta atterrati nello spazioporto, mentre Nnesa lotta con la tenda e il carretto. "È stato un viaggio vero e gioioso." Nnesa li chiama; la tenda richiede chiaramente almeno due persone. Jaasora ti porge il pagamento di <payment> e va ad aiutare, e i due portano fuori l'attrezzatura dalla stiva prima di gridarti un frettoloso ma allegro saluto.
